national_ideas.scope_note: 国家传统、七项国家理念与野心；不含可选理念组、种族/政府加成。多套候选与条件分别列示，不视为同时叠加；形成时是否接受新理念由实际事件/决议与玩家选择决定。

description.text: 在古众矮人之国，独孤领地被视为培养信仰、锻造虔诚之地，每年有数千名矮人前来接受诸神的教会。诸多教会学校中最为著名的是达格林经院（Hul-az-Dagrin）。最为伟大的思想在此专注于经学、写作，以及褒扬他们追随之神的最佳方式。标准是严格无情的，每一个肉体、思想和灵魂都将被仔细而准确地衡量。缺陷是无法容忍的，如果不能在忏悔之砧上敲击成型，那些有缺陷者就会被无情抛弃。
description.text_en: Ovdal-az-Ân was known in ancient Aul-Dwarov as the hold where faith and piety were cultivated, where every year thousands were educated in the ways of Gods. The most famed of these halls of education was the Hul-az-Dagrin, the Hall of Dagrin. Here the greatest minds were sent to learn theology, writing, and the best ways to exalt their gods of choice. Standards were strict, each body, mind, and soul carefully and exactingly measured. Flaws would not be tolerated and if they could not be hammered out upon the anvil of penance, those who bore them would be cast aside.

description.text: 「四星之月」是一件古老的魔法神器，据说是魔法与月之女神约兹塔兰娜在创造矮人种族时遗留下来的碎片，在远远早于众矮人之国的时代由乌尔萨兹恩精心锻造而成，允许使用者施放出远远超过普通法师极限的强力魔法——前提是他们自己有施展魔法的天赋。「四星之月」看起来是一柄约三尺长的权杖，通体由未知的金属材料铸就，足以令任何研究它的冶金学家感到困惑，它由每一任哈兰娜大祭司持有，是他们权力、职位和崇敬的象征。
description.text_en: Vûrodrmonir is an ancient artefact, said to be a fragment of Joztralanna herself, the Goddess of the Moon and origin of magic, leftover from the creation of Dwarvenkind. Crafted by Urisazirn in an age long before Aul-Dwarov, Vûrodrmonir allows the wielder to cast powerful magics far beyond the ability of normal mages, so long as they are capable of magic themselves. Itself a sceptre, roughly three feet long, composed of an unknown metallic material that baffled any and all metallurgists who studied it, Vûrodrmonir was the possession of the High Priest of Halanna, their symbol of power, office, and reverence.

description.text: 当其余矮人对古老之道的崇敬动摇时，花岗岩矮人不为所动。当火炮城开始驱逐信徒时，花岗岩矮人张开双臂欢迎难民。当其他领地开始抛弃诸神时，花岗岩矮人一如既往地尊崇那些陪伴矮人经历无数次审判轮回的神祇，特别是众矮人之母哈兰娜。不信者在这一过程中被烧死，而花岗岩矮人得到了生命的回报。当石之树因其异端而被推翻时，花岗岩矮人们已经隐藏了前往他们领地的入口，从而在数千年后依然保持了安全。在那段漫长到让人觉得孤独的时光中，他们一直居住在独孤领地的花岗岩大厅里，岿然不动，直至永恒。
description.text_en: Where others faltered in their reverence of the Old Ways, the Granite Dwarves did not. When Ovdal Kanzad cast out the faithful, Ovdal-az-Ân welcomed them with open arms. As others began to wane in their devotion and faith, they did not abandon the Gods who had seen them through trial after trial, especially Halanna, mother of all dwarves. In so doing, they were rewarded with life, even as the impious around them burned. They hid the entry to their hold when the Tree of Stone was cast down for its heresy and so remained safe for millennia more. In the granite halls of Ovdal-az-Ân they dwelled, unmoving and eternal.

description.text: 灰元前2203年，传奇的奥德娜二世——不仅是独孤领地的女王，也是哈兰娜的女大祭司——下令封印独孤领地。这项措施并非轻率之举，只因石之树内部的异端和危险之严重，不得不采取如此严厉的措施。女王进行了长达一个月的庄严祈祷，在此期间，领地的符文工匠开始用雕刻有特定符文的花岗岩封住大门。最后，奥德娜女王用「四星之月」在大门上编织了一道复杂的法咒，并颁布敕令，规定大门必须在经过5000年后才能再次打开，那时，如今充斥着异端邪说的世界将对真信徒而言再次安全。因此，花岗岩矮人将自己与世界隔绝，成为母亲哈兰娜的一部分，宛如蛇脊山脉本身。
description.text_en: In 2203 BA, the legendary Odna II, both Queen of Ovdal-az-Ân and High Priestess of Halanna, ordered the sealing of Ovdal-az-Ân. This measure was not made lightly, but the heresy and dangers within the Tree of Stone were deemed extreme enough, to require such a drastic measure. A month-long period of solemn reflection was taken, during which time the hold's Runeworkers sealed the gate with specially runecarved granite blocks and Queen Odna used Vûrodrmonir to weave a complex spell over the gates. It was decreed, that the gates would only open again after 5,000 years had passed and the heretical world was once again safe for true believers. Thus did the Granite dwarves seal themselves off from the world, becoming as much a part of mother Halanna as the mountains themselves.

description.text: 领地猪是一种特殊的培育猪品种，这是一个独特的猪种，是古代众矮人之国的主食，也是独孤领地在陨落之前就很出名的东西。在宣布从翠玉帝国独立后，该地区的许多农民试图通过饲养更大、更多的猪来缓解人力和供应短缺的问题，这些猪更适合于拖动和拉动马车。当洛斯兽流感爆发时，该地区的洛斯兽减少了，这进一步巩固了独孤领地作为石之树其他地区的猪群领地的声誉。
description.text_en: Hold Hogs are a type of Serpentspine creature, a distinctive breed of swine that was a staple meat of ancient Aul-Dwarov, and something Ovdal-az-Ân was famed for before the Fall. After their declaration of independence from the Jade Empire, many farmers in the hold sought to alleviate manpower and supply shortages by breeding larger and stockier hogs, more fit for hauling and pulling wagons. When an outbreak of Rotheflu decimated the hold's population of Rothe, it only further cemented Ovdal-az-Ân's reputation as a hold of swine with the rest of the Tree of Stone.

description.text: 独孤领地的中心是一个巨大的洞穴，在它的中心，一把雕刻精美的石质匕首悬挂在天花板上。这是坚岩大教堂，在众矮人之国的鼎盛时期，是哈兰娜崇拜的中心。坚岩大教堂的钟乳石群被挖空，雕刻成了一座供奉哈兰娜的巨型神庙建筑群，是独孤领地君主统治的权力之地。教堂周围环绕着数十座神庙，供奉着其余的诸神，这些神庙是由较小的石笋或钟乳石建造的，没有一个像坚岩大教堂本身那般美妙。
description.text_en: In the heart of Ovdal-az-Ân n sits a cavern of immense size, and at its heart an elegantly sculpted dagger of stone hangs from the ceiling. This is Argrâstun Cathedral, the centre of the cult of Halanna during the height of Aul-Dwarov. The stalactite, which Argrâstun Cathedral is made from, has been hollowed out into a massive temple complex dedicated to Halanna and is the seat of power from which the monarch ruled. Surrounded by dozens of other hanging temples to other gods, built from lesser stalagmites or stalactites that radiate out from it, the great cavern of Ovdal-az-Ân was a breathtaking site, with no part as wonderous or well adorned as Argrâstun.

description.text: 在灰元1435年，不可思议的事情发生了。独孤领地长久以来所享受的孤立被打破，一大群地精冲破了漫长的无人大门，奥德娜的幻术在机缘巧合下被刺穿了。仅仅在几个小时内，领地上层的整个区域都挤满了地精，他们似乎更感兴趣的是把矮人当作奴隶，而非掠夺。在匆忙重新建立防御前，成千上万的矮人就被抓住了，而即使如此，独孤领地剩余部分的动员也依旧缓慢。随着围攻的继续，更多的地精被吸引到领地内，短短几年间，独孤领地已经沦陷。只有在阴影中，一些顽强的灵魂才留下来，为他们的生存而战。
description.text_en: In 1435 AA, the unthinkable occurred. The isolation that Ovdal-az-Ân had so long enjoyed was broken, as a horde of goblins broke through the long-unmanned gate, the illusion of Odna pierced by mere chance. Within hours, entire sections of the upper level were swarmed by goblins, who seemed more interested in taking dwarves as slaves than plundering. Thousands were captured before a proper defence could be mounted and even then, the mobilisation was slow. As the siege continued, more goblins were drawn to the hold and within a few short years, the hold of Ovdal-az-Ân had fallen. Only in the shadows did a few hardy souls remain, fighting an ever more desperate war for their survival.

player_overview.avoid_if: 想从1444年直接选择成型国家，或不愿游玩排外清洗主题的玩家。
player_overview.how_it_plays: 先夺堡形成I19，再修复矿堡与宗教中心，最后以符文要塞和遗物法术统治山脉。
player_overview.overview: 独孤领地并不是1444年现成的矮人国：矿堡已落入地精手中，你要先以矮人冒险团夺回它、重建国家。其后从废墟档案与万神殿信仰出发，修筑矿堡、重启朝圣与符文工程，最终在石之树形成强大的宗教魔法国度。它的代价是漫长的形成与建设，以及任务中针对地精的清洗和极端排外。
player_overview.recommended_for: 喜欢矮人矿堡、宗教魔法和防守建设型长战役的玩家。
signature_features: 先从地精手中夺堡，再以冒险团重建国家。
万神殿、符文工事与神圣遗物共同推动魔法工程。
任务真正要求隔绝外交并把石之树变为防守圣域。
player_overview.tagline: 夺回失陷的唯一之堡，把宗教遗产、符文魔法和山脉防线铸成封闭圣域。
